checks.note: SecretService.fetchSecret does call findOneByVersionAndBusId with no status filter (unlike fetchLatestActiveSecretAsBytes, which filters on EntityStatus.ACTIVE), so the in-file trigger holds; but the consequence depends on JwtConfiguration/JwtSecretService caching the secret for the process lifetime and on SecurityAdviceFilter/JwtUtil never re-reading or checking status — none of that code is shown, and the finding's own verification step requires it.
